subject: Error: geom_rect requires the following missing aesthetics: xmin,  xmax

messages.author: af86cba19bdad2cf
messages.subject: Error: geom_rect requires the following missing aesthetics: xmin,  xmax
parts:
Hi,
I have a problem with geom_rect. I have a plot of Postion (x axis) vs
Ratio (y axis) and I want to highlight the position axis with 6
different colours so I'm doing something like this:


(np <- qplot(Position, Ratio, data=gc, geom="line"))

yrng <- range(gc$Ratio)
xrng <- range(gc$Position)

np + geom_rect(aes(NULL, NULL, xmin = start, xmax = end, fill =
Chromosome.number), ymin = yrng[1], ymax = yrng[2], data = gc) +
scale_fill_manual(values =alpha(c("blue", "red", "green", "yellow",
"orange", "white"), 0.2))

And its giving me the error:
Error: geom_rect requires the following missing aesthetics: xmin, xmax

Any help please?





The data frame that I am trying to load has the following format:
which I am loading with: gc<-read.table(file.name, header=TRUE)
